name: renderable_param_scene
note: Issue #232: a 'tinted' node carries an authored renderable_constants 'tint' override and a pulse_tint_on_frame behavior. One tick makes the behavior emit SET_RENDERABLE_PARAM('tint', 0.9, 0.1, 0.4); the host resolves the name hash against the node's authored override and writes it (alpha preserved). The override lives on the stable node, so it survives a structural rebuild. No geometry is needed — the test asserts the override field, not a draw.
